name: Tupolev Tu-144D
summary: The Soviet supersonic airliner: an ogival delta wing, four engines in paired boxes under the wing, a nose that droops for landing and retractable canards behind the cockpit.

asset.author: Tu-144D for FlightGear team (ShFsn, femboywings, konsni and contributors)

verify.note: With the gear lowered from its own animations, the oleos settled half a foot and the aircraft resting nose-high on all its wheels as the flight model has it, the FlightGear model measures 64.84 m long and 12.49 m tall against the published 65.7 m and 12.5 m.
